policy: NO official LBMA Gold Price figure is published in this dataset. The LBMA's own page states that the historical tabulated prices moved to the MyLBMA Portal and that a licence from ICE Benchmark Administration (IBA) is required to obtain, use or redistribute benchmark data. Publishing an unlicensed 'LBMA price' number would be unsourced, so instead this file records timestamped observations from named publishers, each with a link and a literal excerpt, and the calculator requires the user to pick or enter a price.

benchmark.name: LBMA Gold Price
facts: The LBMA Gold Price is set twice daily in auctions independently operated and administered by ICE Benchmark Administration Limited (IBA) and commencing at 10:30 and 15:00 London time.
Sterling and Euro prices are available but they are indicative prices for settlement only.
LBMA Precious Metal Prices are not published on either weekends or those days designated as UK bank holidays.
The historical tabulated data for the LBMA Precious Metals Prices has been moved to the MyLBMA Portal; a relevant licence from IBA is required to view it.
A licence from IBA is required in order to obtain, use or redistribute real-time or historical benchmark data.

24K.source: Jewelers of America quality-marks table via research/gold-purity.md (states '24K; European mark 999; 99.99% pure gold')
24K.note: 24/24 is nominally 100% pure, but the published industry quality mark is 999 and the Jewelers of America table records 99.99%. The nominal and the practical figure differ, so both are recorded rather than one being inferred.

18K.source: FTC 'Buying Platinum, Gold, and Silver Jewelry'; Jewelers of America via research/gold-purity.md

constants.karat_formula: pure gold fraction = karat / 24; gold grams = total grams x (karat / 24)
constants.value_formula: gold value = gold grams / 31.1034768 x USD per troy ounce

flags: F-01: No official LBMA Gold Price NUMERIC value is published here because LBMA/IBA gate the tabulated data behind a licence (MyLBMA Portal). Verified live from lbma.org.uk on 2026-10-22.

F-04: The 16 observations for 2026-10-22 disagree by several tens of dollars per ounce because they are captured at different times of day and some are futures/CFD-derived rather than spot. Any single 'current gold price' claim without a timestamp and publisher is unreliable.

F-03: All observations except the LBMA methodology page are tier 'snippet' (read from a search index of the publisher's own page) because the fetch proxy was failing during this session; none were re-confirmed by a live fetch.
